why: The documented skip in C++: a call to a sibling method resolves, a call through a reference parameter does not. C++ skips it silently where C invents a target for the equivalent shape — two front-ends, same question, opposite failure modes.
excluded: The `known_gaps` this case carried are gone, and not because they were waived: the front-end learned to emit every edge they named, so each entry had become an assertion that a limitation still existed when it did not. Found 2026-09-21 by the check added alongside — a gap naming an edge the extractor now emits fails the case to load, the same way a broken `refusal` does. Until then load-time validation only asked whether the gap named an edge in `edges`, which a closed gap still satisfies.
